summary: Nam Tai Property Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting its Q1 2026 unaudited financial results for the period ended March 31, 2026. The filing discloses revenue of $6.9M, a net loss of $6.3M, and basic loss per share of $0.10. It notes the closing of the sale of the Wuxi property and an equity-for-rent initiative representing a 2% stake for RMB 0.5M. No transaction, activist, or strategic event is announced; this is a routine earnings release by a foreign private issuer. The OTC-listed company provides no special-situation catalyst.
